sec.title: September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 647)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across Carlton E. Morse's three adventure serial cycles (*The Decapitation of Jefferson Monk*, *The Girl in the Gilded Cage*, and *The Cobra King Strikes Back*), federal Treasury Department crime investigations, live aviation history broadcasts, and department store detective cases, Carlton E. Morse in *I Love a Mystery* (1943, 1951, 1952), Frank Lovejoy as *Treasury Agent* (1957), Parks Johnson and Warren Hull on *Vox Pop* celebrating United Air Lines (1945), and *Eno Crime Clues* (1935–1957):
